**How do I find one layer in a long PSD**
1. In Chat Studio, click “Full editor →” to open these Pro controls, then continue with the steps below.
2. Open the LAYERS tab.
3. Type part of the name in the "filter..." box (top right of the list); Escape clears it.
4. Alt+click an eye icon to see only that layer.
Exact controls: Filter layers box (Pro > LAYERS tab > top right); LAYERS (Pro > right column > tabs).

**Find the number layer**
1. Open the LAYERS tab and look for a layer named Numbers or a car-specific number layer.
2. Select that row to make it active; use its eye control only to show or hide it.

**Spec-only changes  without touching the paint**
Use a FOUNDATION finish (base::f_*) with color "source" on a zone that covers the area: it changes the spec map and leaves the paint exactly as it is (measured on real templates: 0% paint change). NEVER base::chrome, base::metallic or base::candy for this: those repaint the car (78-85% of the hood changed in the test). Looks: mirror chrome = base::f_chrome, satin chrome = base::f_satin_chrome, dark chrome = base::f_dark_chrome

3. Click "+ Add Zone".
4. In COLOR click "PICK COLOR FROM CAR", then click a red spot on the car. Raise the tolerance if red edges are left.
5. In BASE pick a finish.

**How do I undo**
1. In Chat Studio, click “Full editor →” to open these Pro controls, then continue with the steps below.
2. Press Ctrl+Z, or the Undo button in the top toolbar (HISTORY menu).
3. To go back several steps open "Undo History...".
4. Under an AI panel answer press Undo to take back that whole answer. In Easy use UNDO at the top.
Exact controls: Undo Ctrl+Z (Pro > top toolbar (tool row)); Undo History… (Pro > top toolbar (tool row)); Undo (Shokker AI panel).

**Pro: Selection / mask bar**
Under the canvas: Include / Exclude brushes, Undo / Redo, Deselect, Invert, Grow / Shrink / Feather / Smooth, Copy / Mirror mask, Zoom to selection. Where: Pro > centre > selection / mask bar under the canvas. - **Include** (button): paint areas to KEEP in zone's color match (green overlay) - **Exclude** (button): paint areas to REMOVE from zone's color match (red overlay) - **Undo** (button): Undo last stroke (Ctrl+Z) - **Redo** (button): Redo l

**Talking it through: follow-ups that point at what you were just shown**
The copilot remembers the list it just showed, so you can talk to it like a person: - **Point at one:** "tell me about the second one", "I like the second one but more sparkly", "use the third one". - **Like X but ...:** "something like Undertow but calmer", "like chrome but darker", "texture like carbon fiber but finer". Changes it understands: calmer, bolder, darker, lighter, glossier, flatter, more /

**How do I use Easy mode (paint by numbers)**
1. Shokker finds the colours and gives each a finish. Tap any part of the car (or a row on the right) to change it.
2. Pick a finish card, keep your colour or take the finish's colour, adjust Blend / Size / Color.
3. Choose your car, check the READY TO RACE checklist, then SAVE TO iRACING.

**What are layers**
1. In Chat Studio, click “Full editor →” to open these Pro controls, then continue with the steps below.
2. A layered PSD keeps parts of the livery on separate sheets: Car Paint (body colours), Numbers, Sponsors, Tape, Decals.
3. Layers let you change one thing (just the numbers) without touching the rest.
4. Template layers (Mask, Wire, Car_Mandatory) only show the car outlines and must be OFF when you render.

**Get it into iRacing** - here is where:
1. Set iRacing Car Folder + iRacing User ID (top bar) (the User ID is your iRacing customer ID).
2. Press RENDER (centre, above the preview) - the files land in that folder.
3. In iRacing open the car’s paint shop / garage: the custom paint loads there.
Exact controls: IRACING USER ID box (Pro > top row > iRacing User ID); IRACING CAR FOLDER box (Pro > top of the window (header rows)); RENDER (Pro > centre > RENDER button).
